What's a movie you've been waiting your whole life to see, yet it's never been made?

I don't know if it hasn't been made yet, but I think I'd really love to see a series of movies that seemingly start out as two separate franchises, but eventually meet into one. And no crossover bullshit, I want to be able to look back and have it all click that both franchises were part of the same story all along.

So as an example of how this would work conceptually, one "side" of the movies will follow a protagonist who dedicates his life to building an empire. We see and understand his motivations, his reasoning, and empathize with the sacrifices he has to make and the necessary evils that he tolerates to fulfill his vision.

On the other side of the coin we'll follow a protagonist who starts his journey in misery, whose people are downtrodden and oppressed by a tyrannical dictator, who fights to see that this evil is righted. As the movie franchises go on, it's slowly revealed that each is the other movie's antagonist.

So I guess a tiny bit like Star Wars' original/prequel films, but less one-sided.
